task: CLI pipeline file/artifact handoff resource risk review

resource_risks.description: A future runner could leave temporary files or caches behind if cleanup policy is not explicit.
resource_risks.mitigation: The pipeline contract requires cleanup_policy for temp_file and cache artifacts before readiness.

resource_risks.description: A future file handoff runner could leak file handles if stream and file lifecycle are not recorded.
resource_risks.mitigation: The resource_controls cleanup_policy now explicitly covers file handles, and artifact validation requires validation and size bounds.

lifecycle_checks.create_path: No runner implemented in this change.
lifecycle_checks.cleanup_path: Not applicable because this change adds validation contracts only.
lifecycle_checks.rationale: The current change does not open files, create temp files, or spawn subprocesses.

measurement_checks.metric: Open file handles, temp-file count, and artifact size growth
measurement_checks.threshold: Not applicable until a real runner exists.
measurement_checks.rationale: No executable file-producing orchestration runtime was added.

notes: Future runner implementation must add real lifecycle and measurement checks for file handles and temporary artifacts.
